description: Source-verified structural and component-order validation cases for modern Burmese Unicode.
derivation: Cases were manually constructed from Unicode 17 Table 16-4 ordering and the published Burmese syllable structures. Failure categories and mixed-text behavior are project-authored API decisions.

cases.basis: Empty input contains no invalid Burmese structure.
Medial ya, vowel e, vowel aa, devowelised final, and visarga occur in supported order.

cases.input: မြန်မာစာကောင်းပါတယ်
cases.basis: The source-backed syllable structures compose across text without spaces.

cases.input: မင်္ဂလာ ဝတ္ထု ယောက်ျား နုဿီ
cases.basis: Documented kinzi, virama chaining, written contraction, and Great Sa no-break structures are supported.
Unicode requires canonically equivalent asat and dot-below orders to be treated as the same text.
The Burmese validator ignores non-Myanmar text and separators.
A dependent vowel cannot begin a supported Burmese syllable.
Virama requires a following supported subjoined consonant.
U+1009 is outside the Unicode 17 modern Burmese subscript-consonant set.
Medial ra must precede medial wa in the Unicode component order.
Vowel e must precede vowel aa in encoded component order.
The same medial component cannot occur twice in one component sequence.
The upper-vowel slot cannot occur twice in one component sequence.
Asat cannot occur twice at the same attachment position.
A subscript consonant must precede vowel components.
The source-backed Burmese profile treats Great Sa as dependent on a preceding consonant.
A Shan letter is outside this explicitly Burmese-only validation profile.
Diagnostic spans use Unicode code-point offsets rather than UTF-16 code units.
